prompts.name: song
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW tabletop game token status marker named SONG. Attached flame is GRAPHIC STYLE reference ONLY: match its thick very dark colored outer contours, saturated clean layered DRAWN shadow shapes, broad crisp highlights and dimensional illustrated fantasy-game volume, no painterly texture. Main subject ONE unmistakable MUSICAL EIGHTH NOTE: one large rounded oval notehead at lower left, one stout straight vertical stem rising from its right side and one graceful substantial flag curving rightward from its top. Compact, bold and near-square overall proportions, not a thin typographic glyph. Rich cobalt blue and violet shaded body with bright cyan-lavender highlights, dark navy contour and a few broad bevel highlights giving sculpted volume. Keep the notehead very substantial and the stem thick enough to remain visible at 32–48px. Moderate polished illustrative detail matching the reference, no tiny filigree or extra floating notes, no sound waves, stars, glitter, aura or particles. No text, staff lines, lettering, background, circle or badge. Entire music note clearly visible, centered on square actual transparent canvas with comfortable margins, fills about 80–85% of canvas height and most of its width.

prompts.name: disabled
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW tabletop game status marker DISABLED, using the universal PROHIBITION symbol like the emoji 🚫. Attached flame is GRAPHIC STYLE reference ONLY: thick near-black colored contours, saturated clean layered DRAWN shadows, broad crisp highlights and dimensional illustrated fantasy-game finish, no painterly texture. Subject exactly ONE bold RED CIRCLE with ONE thick straight diagonal red slash from UPPER LEFT to LOWER RIGHT, seamlessly connected to the ring at both ends. Ring must be truly round, no perspective ellipse; slash is perfectly straight with constant width. Substantial crimson-red body, rich ruby shadow planes, brighter scarlet upper highlights and two or three broad restrained pale-red reflections giving a sculpted bevelled volume. Thick very dark burgundy exterior and interior outlines define the ring and slash. Clear open spaces on both sides of slash are genuinely TRANSPARENT, no white disk, black fill, central icon, letters or object being crossed out. Match established fantasy token icons through drawn volume and rich outlines, while keeping this simple symbol immediately recognizable and readable at 32–48px. No glitter, stars, bolts, spikes, cracks, brush texture, neon aura, extra symbols, text, background plaque, stand or additional surrounding badge. Full compact complete design centered on square actual transparent canvas, about 85% canvas diameter with comfortable even margins.
